description: This Java class 'ClusterStatus' represents the state of an Akka cluster, including information such as reachable and unreachable members, cluster roles, leader, and members that have seen the current cluster state. It provides methods for constructing instances, serializing to JSON, and accessing cluster status information.

classes.name: ClusterStatus
classes.description: Immutable class representing the status of an Akka cluster, including members, roles, and leader information, with serialization to JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClusterStatus instance with specified cluster data.

methods.name: getReachable
methods.description: Returns the set of reachable cluster members.

methods.name: getUnreachable
methods.description: Returns the set of unreachable cluster members.

methods.name: getSeenBy
methods.description: Returns the set of members that have seen this cluster state.

methods.name: getLeader
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the leader address if available.

methods.name: getOwnRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles this cluster member has.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of ClusterRoleStatus objects representing roles and their status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ClusterStatus object to a JSON representation.
